summary: KB Editor Callout Visual Blocks - All 8 features tested and verified. Insert menu shows 6 callout types (Info, Check, Note, Tip, Warning, Danger). Slash command menu shows 6 callout types under 'Callouts' group. Callout blocks render as visual components (not raw MDX code). Each callout has correct icon and colored background. Callouts are editable and deletable.

minor_warnings.issue: TipTap console warning: 'Duplicate extension names found: [link, underline]'. StarterKit includes these by default, and they're added again separately.
minor_warnings.impact: No functional impact, just console noise

critical_code_review_comments: CalloutBlock.jsx is well-structured with proper data-testid attributes for testing
All 6 callout types have distinct colors and icons as specified
Markdown serialization properly converts visual blocks back to <Callout> MDX syntax
Minor: Consider configuring StarterKit to exclude 'link' and 'underline' to avoid duplicate extension warning
seed_data_creation: None required - tested with new article creation
context_for_next_testing_agent: KB Editor callout visual blocks fully implemented and tested. All 6 types (info, check, note, tip, warning, danger) work in both Insert menu and Slash command menu. Callouts render as visual blocks with correct styling, are editable, and can be deleted. Auth bypass uses page.route mock for /api/auth/me.
